subject.title: fix: include plugin LLM calls in usage diagnostics

question: Should the existing token, cost, context, and usage-span contracts gain a permanent bounded plugin dimension, while the agent-run duration metric retains its current attribute shape?
rationale: The missing accounting is a bug, but changing exported metric dimensions is a public observability compatibility choice that source correctness and green CI cannot settle.

options.title: Accept Narrow Attribution
options.body: Preserve the duration metric's current attributes, add plugin attribution only to applicable usage telemetry, and require exact-head live exporter proof before merge.

options.title: Accept Uniform Label Expansion
options.body: Keep the plugin field on every model-usage metric, explicitly document that duration samples remain `plugin="none"`, and accept the downstream dashboard migration cost.

options.title: Preserve Existing Metrics
options.body: Avoid changing current metric dimensions by introducing separately named plugin-attributed telemetry or another compatibility-preserving export path.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Attribution
recommendation.body: Preserve the duration metric's current attributes, add plugin attribution only to applicable usage telemetry, and require exact-head live exporter proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history shows the strongest sustained involvement across the affected plugin-runtime and diagnostics surfaces.
